decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical BIOS parameter block structure.
evidence: The file matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS, DOS and COMMAND sources include bpb.inc, which declares the BPB fields and six trailing bytes.
Previously selected BIOS MSDISK and MSDIOCTL module contributions match the corresponding IO.SYS target bytes (reviews 011 and 012).
In the DOS IOCTL module comparison all 22 differing bytes are assembler-marked relocations, among 735 compared bytes (review 073).
Reconstructed COMMAND DIR comparison matches 2114 non-relocation bytes and 78 internal branches at an inferred target location (review 122).
limitations: Prior module comparisons support only BPB definitions exercised by those selected configurations, and do not establish historical source identity or final whole-file equality.
